diet.noneHint: All recipes, with or without meat.

onboarding.welcomeBody: MealWise turns your week of meals into a ready-to-shop grocery list.
onboarding.point1: Plan breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for the whole week
onboarding.point2: Get a grocery list that adds up ingredients for you
onboarding.point3: Track what's in your fridge and what's about to expire
onboarding.point4: Works offline. Your data stays on your phone.
onboarding.regionBody: Recipes adapt to the measures and currency you use. You can change this later.
onboarding.householdBody: We use this as the default number of servings when you plan a meal.
onboarding.privacyNote: No account needed. MealWise never sends your recipes, lists or pantry to a server.

home.noList: No list yet — create one from your plan
home.noFavoritesHint: Tap the heart on a recipe to find it here.
home.emptyWeekBody: Start from a ready-made plan and adjust it to your taste.

planner.title: Meal planner
planner.calendarHint: Tap an empty cell to add a meal, or a meal to edit it.
planner.customHint: Custom meals appear in your plan but don't add ingredients to the grocery list.
planner.entryGone: This meal is no longer in your plan
planner.moveHint: Move this meal to another day or meal time.
planner.duplicateHint: Add the same meal again, for example to cook it twice.
planner.copyDayHint: Copy every meal of this day to another day.
planner.removeBody: It will be removed from your plan. The recipe is kept.
planner.copyWeekBody: All meals will be added to the same days of next week.
planner.clearWeekBody: Every planned meal of this week will be removed.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.searchPlaceholder: Search a recipe or an ingredient
recipes.noResultsHint: Try another word or remove a filter.
recipes.noMine: Create your own recipe or import one from text.

recipe.scaledFrom_one: Quantities adjusted from the original recipe ({{count}} serving).
recipe.scaledFrom_other: Quantities adjusted from the original recipe ({{count}} servings).
recipe.deleteBody: It will be deleted from your recipe book. Planned meals keep their name.

editor.title: Recipe
editor.name: Recipe name
editor.quickAddHint: Type quantity, unit and ingredient on one line, then tap +.
editor.nutritionHint: Only fill this in if you know the values per serving (from packaging or a reliable source). Otherwise MealWise shows an estimate.
editor.discardBody: Your changes to this recipe won't be saved.

errors.title: Give your recipe a name.
errors.time: Times must be between 0 and 1440 minutes.

import.title: Import a recipe
import.intro: Paste a recipe written as text: a title, an ingredient list and the steps. You'll review everything before saving.
import.placeholder:
Lemon pasta
Serves 2

Ingredients
200 g spaghetti
1 lemon
2 tbsp olive oil

Steps
1. Cook the pasta for 10 minutes…
import.skipped_one: {{count}} line could not be understood — check it in the editor.
import.skipped_other: {{count}} lines could not be understood — check them in the editor.
import.privacy: Import works entirely on your phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.

grocery.title: Grocery list
grocery.addPlaceholder: Add an item, e.g. 1 l milk
grocery.emptyBody: Plan a few meals, then MealWise adds up everything you need.
grocery.listEmptyHint: Add items above or update the list from your plan.
grocery.priceNote: Prices are your own estimates. MealWise doesn't know shop prices.
grocery.deleteListBody: The list and its items will be deleted.
grocery.usePantryHint: Subtract matching items from your pantry.
grocery.refreshActiveHint: Keeps items you added and what you've already checked.
grocery.previewSummary: {{meals}} planned meals → {{items}} items to buy ({{covered}} already in your pantry)
grocery.noMeals: No recipe is planned in this period yet.
grocery.mergeNote: Identical ingredients are added together only when their units are compatible (e.g. g with kg). Otherwise they stay on separate lines.

pantry.title: Pantry
pantry.expiryNote: Always check the date and the product itself. MealWise only reminds you of the date you entered.
pantry.emptyBody: Add what you have at home to get expiry reminders and recipe ideas.
pantry.almost_one: {{count}} recipe missing only a few items
pantry.almost_other: {{count}} recipes missing only a few items
pantry.noMatch: No recipe matches your pantry yet
pantry.cookEmpty: Add products to your pantry to see what you can cook.
pantry.cookNote: Salt, pepper, oil and water are assumed to be at home.

nutrition.title: Nutrition insights
nutrition.unavailable: Not enough data to estimate this recipe.
nutrition.documentedNote: Values entered by the recipe author.
nutrition.estimateNote: Rough estimate from generic ingredient averages ({{percent}} % of the ingredients). Real values depend on the products you use.
nutrition.missingNote: Some ingredients have no reference data or can't be weighed, so no estimate is shown.
nutrition.disclaimer: For general information only. MealWise is not a medical or dietary tool; ask a health professional for personal advice.
nutrition.noData: No nutrition data for these meals.
nutrition.noMeals: No meal planned on this day.
nutrition.line: ≈ {{kcal}} kcal · P {{protein}} g · C {{carbs}} g · F {{fat}} g
nutrition.splitNote: Estimated from planned meals, one serving each.
nutrition.methodNote: Estimates use one serving of each planned recipe and generic reference values. Missing data is never invented.

budget.title: Food budget
budget.listHint: Finishing a grocery list with the amount paid also records it here.
budget.costCoverage: Based on your saved prices for {{percent}} % of the ingredients.
budget.noPrices: Add prices to your grocery items to estimate what recipes cost.
budget.disclaimer: Amounts are the ones you enter. MealWise does not know real shop prices.

templates.title: Meal templates
templates.mineEmpty: Save a planned week as a menu to reuse it any time.

student.description: Cheap, simple recipes with few ingredients.

history.title: History
history.empty: Recipes you open or cook will appear here.
history.noMealsHint: Finish cooking mode or mark a planned meal as cooked.

premium.recipeLockedBody: Get every recipe, unlimited plans and advanced tools with MealWise Premium.
premium.unlimitedPlansBody: The free plan covers this week and next week. Premium lets you plan as far ahead as you like.
premium.costBody: Premium estimates the cost of each recipe from the prices you save.
premium.pantryBody: Premium suggests recipes you can make with your pantry, and the few items missing.
premium.nutritionBody: See weekly averages and your energy split across meals with Premium.
premium.budgetTitle: Track your spending month by month
premium.budgetBody: Premium shows your monthly food spending history.
premium.exportBody: Exporting plans and lists is part of Premium.

paywall.title: MealWise Premium
paywall.subtitle: Plan every week with ease, waste less and keep your budget in check.
paywall.benefitPlans: Unlimited meal plans, as far ahead as you like
paywall.benefitTemplates: Exclusive templates and unlimited saved menus

paywall.storeUnavailable: Subscriptions are not available on this build or right now. Everything else keeps working.

paywall.restored: Your Premium access has been restored.
paywall.nothingToRestore: No previous purchase was found for this account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.premiumPitch: More recipes, unlimited plans, no ads.

settings.keepOriginal: Show recipes in their original units

notifications.intro: Reminders are created on your phone. Turn on only those you find useful.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for MealWise. You can allow them in Android settings.
notifications.mealPrepHint: A reminder before each planned meal.
notifications.planningHint: A weekly nudge to plan next week's meals.
notifications.shoppingHint: A reminder to do your groceries.
notifications.expiryHint: Before a pantry product reaches its date.
notifications.localOnly: MealWise uses local notifications only: no push server, no tracking.
notifications.mealPrepBody: {{title}} — time to start cooking (in about {{minutes}} min).
notifications.planningBody: Two minutes now, a stress-free week ahead.
notifications.shoppingBody: Your list is ready in MealWise.

data.intro: Everything you create in MealWise is stored on this phone only.
data.backupHint: Save a file with your recipes, plans, lists, pantry and budget, and restore it on any phone.
data.invalidBackup: This file is not a valid MealWise backup.
data.exportPlanHint: This week and next week, as text or as a spreadsheet (CSV).
data.deleteHint: Erases your recipes, plans, lists, pantry, budget and history from this phone. Bundled recipes stay.
data.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Make a backup first if you want to keep anything.
data.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

privacy.point2: Recipes, plans, lists, pantry and budget are stored on your phone only.
privacy.point3: Nothing you type is ever sent to advertising or analytics services.
privacy.point4: You can export or delete all your data at any time.
privacy.analyticsHint: Off by default. Only counts like "a template was used", never your content.
privacy.adsHint: The free version shows a small banner on some screens, never on a recipe or in cooking mode. In regions where consent is required, you are asked first.
privacy.permissionsHint: Notifications only, if you turn reminders on. No camera, location, contacts or storage access.
privacy.notMedical: Nutrition figures are estimates for general information, not medical or dietary advice.
